oneOf.description: 平面环片，外径 = 内径 + 2 × 径向宽度；无额外倒角。
Coaxial tube; defaults 13.4 outer diameter, 12.4 inner diameter and 3 height for the user C-part.
平底、光滑凸面；直径和高度独立设置，可以调整拱高，不限于半球。
A coaxial flange and cylindrical bushing with a straight bore through the full length. Generic parametric geometry, with no threads or source-product feature reconstruction.
同心圆恒截面单圈；开缝为底部正中平行平切。
Sweep round wire along a half-wire outward offset of a true inner ellipse, then cut a bottom-center parallel flat gap. Source drawings with a true outer ellipse need another tool.
Constant-section circular arc with an adjustable opening angle for C rings, hook rings and open circular frames. End balls, hinges and variable sections are excluded.
Circular ring swept from an elliptical section with independent front band width and side depth. Section shape is an editable candidate to verify against the source.

Three dimensions: inner diameter, outer diameter and total thickness. Winding, layer gap, transition and section R are fitted automatically; both tips have circular outlines with rounded edges. Legacy explicit winding recipes remain supported.
Independent inner/outer outlines and thickness. Half-short-side radii allow capsule frames. A parametric tool, not a complete reconstruction of an IGS part.

A flat frame with independent inner and outer corner radii, then one exact fillet of every sharp edge. The specified edge radius fails atomically if unsolvable. Near half-thickness can approximate a round section but is not certified as a semicircle.
Constant-section rounded rectangular frame. A closed round-wire frame supports an inner short side at least 2.5 times the wire diameter; other variants require four times the section size.
Sweep an elliptical cross-section around a rounded rectangular centerline. Front band width and side depth are independent; the inner planar radius is separate from section shape.
Flat D frame with semicircular crown, straight legs, independent inner/outer bottom radii and optional measured bottom gap. Thickness is a flat plate depth, not a round-wire section.
半圆冠、底部圆弯；内高量到下横杠上沿。内高须≥内宽/2+底内R，等号时两直腿为零且圆弧相切。外宽=内宽+2×线径，外高=内高+2×线径。圆线、圆角方线或倒角方线截面。
圆角方线 U 主体与固定圆杆融合；杆底与脚底齐平。
四段相切圆弧，不是椭圆或跑道圈；缝在右端正中。
Closed round-wire capsule loop with exact semicircular ends and straight runs. Set inner width, inner height and wire diameter; an unmarked seam is not guessed.
Closed capsule loop with semicircular ends and straight runs. Front width, side depth and section radius are independent; a half-short-side radius forms an exact stadium section.
A flat plate with two equal symmetric rounded windows and an integral center bridge. Independent outline, window and front/back edge radii. No round bar, offset windows or side arch.

The inner height spans the full frame; the fused round bar has an editable vertical offset and no opening. Compact round-wire frames require an inner short side at least 2.5 wire diameters and each window at least one wire diameter high.
A constant-section circular frame fused to one round X-axis crossbar. The bar has editable Y and depth Z offsets. Moving bars, hinges and exact joint transitions are excluded.
Offset a true inner ellipse for a round-wire sweep and fuse one centered fixed round bar. Read back exact bounds; source spline and joint continuity still require comparison.

Intersect a rounded twin-window footprint with a coaxial cylindrical wall to create an arched plate. Set outer bend radius and radial thickness independently. Projected strip construction without source-specific edge treatment; round-wire frames need another tool.
A flat plate with straight top/bottom, tangent bowed sides and four small corner arcs, plus two symmetric capsule windows. Optional edge fillet. Symmetric parameter model only.
Two symmetric X-axis holes with independent center spacing. Plain through holes only; no threads, countersinks or counterbores.
Rectangular plate with four through holes. Set X/Y edge insets and optional outer corner radius; no threads or counterbores.

A rounded plate with two symmetric hollow cylindrical bosses; each bore passes through both boss and plate. Generic parametric geometry, not a threaded, counterbored, or source-product reconstruction.
来源 V01/V02/V03：顶片双安装孔，两端下折脚、圆弧脚端，可选单脚或双脚轴孔。顶面 Z=0，脚朝 -Z，桥长沿 Y、片宽沿 X；总高含顶片。V02 的收脚由侧边收角和脚端R控制。折角保持来源的直角，不自动加弯R。

Constant-wall open U clip of uniform X width, independent front/back heights and exact tangent bend arcs. An inner radius equal to half the gap makes a semicircular bottom. Bottom Z=0, opening +Z, back wall +Y. Optional 0/1/2 plain back-wall through holes; two holes lie on X. Not a closed cap. No threads, decorations, end blends or elastic deformation. Holes must fit entirely within the straight back wall.

One exact circular or rounded rectangular frame with an optional constant-wall collar, symmetric mounting posts and plain straight holes. Collar and posts extend along local +Z from a flange at Z=0. Hole depth 0 means through; positive depth is blind from the post top. 0/2/4 posts; two posts lie on Y. Zero collar/post heights make a backplate. No threads, taper, riveting, decoration or 3D edge blends. Circular mode requires matching width/height pairs; corner radii apply only to rectangular mode.

Separate tongue: X-axis pivot loop and a rounded flat strip along +Y. Length is pivot-center to tip. Approximate loop-head flat tongue only; no stamping bends, knurling, artwork or assembly motion validation.
Separate crossbar with two open Y-axis rolled eyes and independently tangent inner/outer transitions into the center strip. For regular pull buckles; it remains separate from the frame.
A horizontal rounded rod joined to an elliptical-section U eye that narrows in Z depth from root to top.
A regular round-section U bridge with straight legs, an exact semicircular crown, and optional coaxial holes in both end faces.

Flat-top rectangular-section U bridge with independent inner/outer size, depth, corner and edge radii, and optional paired blind end bores. Structural references PG15272/PG15227; plain bores only, no threads, screws, backing plate or subtle source crown.
头在参考位置下端，牙杆朝本地 +Z。沉头外缘固定直升位 0.20 mm。M 使用常用粗牙螺距，真实 V 型牙槽；不含配合公差。
底面在参考位置，面端朝本地 -Z；从下方面端向上攻牙。牙径采用支持的名义 M 粗牙直径，不含配合公差。
圆线沿精确螺旋路径扫掠。螺距大于线径；半径是中心线半径。

A parameterized two-piece thin-wall eyelet with exact revolved flange bends. Part A has a long shank and Part B is its mating ring. Supports static coaxial fit or exploded display; riveting deformation, logos and lettering are not modeled.

aBendRadiusMm.description: Part A flange bend outer radius

bTubeOuterDiameterMm.description: Part B short tube outer diameter

bBendRadiusMm.description: Part B flange bend outer radius

oneOf.description: Two coaxial opposed alloy eyelet parts inspired by PG14922, without pins. Flat or curved outward faces, chamfered edges and mating collars. Static geometry, no pressing or deformation.

Two-piece nipple stud with an arc-profiled flat-top body, radiused base, blind M2 nominal clearance bore, crowned screw head, stem, and parameterized six-lobe drive. Threads and standardized drive dimensions are not modeled.

boreDiameterMm.description: Part A nominal clearance bore diameter

entryChamferMm.description: Bore entry chamfer depth and radial width

oneOf.description: A parameterized two-piece mushroom rivet with a spherical cap, hollow socket, rounded waisted post and base flange. Supports assembled or exploded display, with a blind post bore depth and direction.
多节按内口受拉贴紧，保留独立链节。来源 OZL.stp：平面椭圆内孔、圆线截面、底部接缝。W/L 为外轮廓尺寸，线径独立；g=0 为闭环。底面 Z=0，长轴 Y。
多节同向嵌接并按内口受拉贴紧；成链时按线径加深中心线起伏，保持外宽、外长和径向线径。原单节来源 NL.stp：椭圆链环呈对角高低起伏，保持来源的扭转曲面。W/L/线径独立调整，不是平面圈整体旋转；接缝位于 -Y 端，g=0 闭合。底面 Z=0。
多节同向嵌接并按内口受拉贴紧，磨面共面；成链时按线径加深中心线起伏，再平磨到设定总厚。原单节来源 ML.stp/NL.stp：扭链上下平磨并保留圆线侧面、底部接缝。磨后总厚控制两侧平面间距；磨边R为固定半径圆角，0 保留锐边。不是把扭链压扁。底面 Z=0。
Tool solid: entry at Z=0, extending along +Z. Position at the workpiece surface, rotate 180 degrees if needed, then select the body first and subtract the tool.
One solid combining a round badge plate, raised front rim and two rear mounting posts. Posts may be hollow. Brand artwork, knurling, doming and production dimensions are excluded.

One fused solid, centered in XY, bottom at Z=0, open top. Clear cavity width/depth = outer width/depth minus twice wall thickness; clear height = height minus floor thickness. Two X-symmetric bosses rise from the inner floor; bores pass through bosses and floor. Straight walls/corners only; no draft, fillets, threads or assembly relationships.

Open rounded-rectangle tray with two hollow bosses on the inner floor. Outer corner radius, wall/floor thickness and boss dimensions are editable. Straight walls only; no draft, clips, lettering or texture.
One flat U plate with concentric semicircular crowns, equal-width straight legs and one through-hole at each end. No second assembly component, thread or round-wire section.

holeInset.description: Hole center inset from leg end

oneOf.description: Annular band segment with editable sweep, plate thickness, symmetric end-hole inset and optional counterbores. Threads and mating parts are separate.
Open gable frame with straight legs, sloped shoulders and rounded open ends. Independent inner/outer widths, shoulder and peak heights, depth and end radius.

numericInputPolicy.kernelTolerance: operation-specific; independent of display and pointer steps

editRule: Patch merges into prior params; complete merged params are validated; generic field deletion is unsupported.
coordinateConvention: faceId, faceIds and edgeIds are zero-based indices of the CURRENT referenced body. body.faceCount/edgeCount define the range. Use current selectedTopology (when available) to identify user-picked face/edge/point. queryGeometry or measure returns exact BRep face type and measures. Counts alone do not identify spatial meaning. Do not guess face orientation. Rebuild may renumber topology; do not reuse IDs across revisions without reinspection. Unified logo accepts one exact planar or supported curved face; faceHole and faceExtrude require planar faces. Template-specific parameters and defaults come from getTool({id:"quickModel"}), not arbitrary geometry code.

sideEffects: Updates active document history and derived view on commit.
permissions: Authorized local modeling session; no external upload.
undoBehavior: One successful feature operation is one undo step. Legacy refresh is separately documented.
idempotency: Current documentInstanceId in-memory receipts only; no cross-reload guarantee.
